description: Defines the rrc_setup_procedure class responsible for handling the RRC setup process in a 3GPP UE context, including creating SRBs, sending RRC setup messages, and forwarding initial UE messages.

classes.name: rrc_setup_procedure
classes.description: Handles the creation and management of the RRC setup procedure for a UE, including signaling and notifier interactions.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the RRC setup procedure asynchronously.

methods.name: create_srb1
methods.description: Instructs the DU processor to create SRB1 bearer.

methods.name: send_rrc_setup
methods.description: Sends the RRC Setup message as per 3GPP TS 36.331 section 5.3.3.

methods.name: send_initial_ue_msg
methods.description: Forwards the initial UE message to NGAP.

methods.name: establishment_cause_to_resume_cause
methods.description: Converts establishment cause to resume cause.
